text: Shemagh Al Bassam is the shemagh brand and store of Mohammed Al-Saad Al-Ajlan Sons Co. (شركة أبناء محمد السعد العجلان, named in the site footer); its FAQ says the shemaghs come from the company's own factories.
short: Shemagh Al Bassam belongs to Mohammed Al-Saad Al-Ajlan Sons Co.

source.name: Shemagh Al Bassam store (alajlanonline.com): FAQ
source.quote: يتوفر شماغ البسام بالصناعة الانجليزية في بريطانيا و لنا مصانعنا الخاصة هناك
source.note: Translation: 'Al-Bassam shemagh is available in English manufacture in Britain and we have our own factories there.' The live page blocks scripts (403); archived copy of 2026-04-06 used. The site footer names the operator as شركة أبناء محمد السعد العجلان (Mohammed Al-Saad Al-Ajlan Sons Co.).
